gloss: to project; to reflect; to portray

definitions.gloss: to project, to display (on a screen or surface)
definitions.explanation: To show an image, video, or visual content on a screen, wall, or other surface using a projector, camera, or similar device.

definitions.gloss: to reflect, to reveal, to portray
definitions.explanation: To make something visible or apparent; to depict or represent a situation, emotion, or reality. Used figuratively for media, art, or observation.

examples.japanese: スクリーンに{映像|えいぞう}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To project an image on the screen.

examples.japanese: カメラが{夜|よる}の{街|まち}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The camera projected the nighttime cityscape.

examples.japanese: プロジェクターが{壁|かべ}に{大|おお}きな{地図|ちず}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}し、{参加者|さんかしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}が{確認|かくにん}できた。
examples.english: The projector displayed a large map on the wall so all participants could see it.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}は{戦後|せんご}の{現実|げんじつ}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}している。
examples.english: That film portrays the postwar reality.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{表情|ひょうじょう}が{不安|ふあん}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}していた。
この{小説|しょうせつ}は{現代|げんだい}{社会|しゃかい}の{矛盾|むじゅん}を{鮮|あざ}やかに{映|うつ}し{出|だ}している。
examples.english: This novel vividly portrays the contradictions of modern society.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), す-ending.
- Negative: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}さない
- Polite: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}します
- Te-form: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}して
- Past: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}した

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映像|えいぞう}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}す: to project footage
- {現実|げんじつ}を{映|うつ}し{出|だ}す: to reflect/portray reality
- スクリーンに{映|うつ}し{出|だ}す: to project onto a screen

NOTE:
The compound structure {映|うつ}す + {出|だ}す combines "to project/reflect" with "to bring out," emphasizing that something is made visible or brought to light.
